description: BIP 375 Test Vectors - Sending Silent Payments with PSBTs

invalid.description: Missing DLEQ proof for ECDH share
Mixed segwit versions with silent payments
invalid.error: Silent payment outputs present with segwit version > 1 inputs
PSBT_OUT_SP_V0_INFO present but PSBT_OUT_SCRIPT not computed
PSBT_OUT_SCRIPT does not match BIP 352 derivation from ECDH shares

invalid.error: Both PSBT_GLOBAL_SP_ECDH_SHARE and PSBT_IN_SP_ECDH_SHARE present for same scan key
Silent payment outputs require SIGHASH_ALL signatures only

invalid.description: ECDH share without corresponding input public key
invalid.error: PSBT_IN_SP_ECDH_SHARE present but input public key unavailable

invalid.description: Invalid scan key in ECDH share
invalid.error: Scan key in ECDH share is not a valid compressed public key

valid.description: Single signer with global ECDH share
valid.note: One entity controls all inputs, uses global approach for efficiency
Two signers each contribute ECDH shares for their respective inputs
Uses PSBT_OUT_SP_V0_LABEL and BIP32 derivation for change identification

valid.description: Multiple silent payment outputs to same scan key
valid.note: Two outputs to same silent payment address, different k values

valid.description: Mixed regular and silent payment outputs
valid.note: Transaction with both regular P2WPKH outputs and silent payment outputs
Per-input ECDH shares with DLEQ proofs for hardware wallet verification
2-of-3 multisig inputs sending to silent payment address
Only required fields present, no optional derivation paths

valid.description: Large transaction with multiple silent payments
valid.note: 10 inputs, 5 outputs including 3 different silent payment addresses

valid.description: Edge case: single input single silent payment output

test_generation_notes: All test vectors should be generated using test_generator.py
Each PSBT should be complete and ready for transaction extraction
Invalid cases should fail at specific validation points
Valid cases should successfully extract to broadcastable transactions
Include both compressed and uncompressed key scenarios where applicable
Test edge cases like maximum transaction sizes and field counts
Ensure DLEQ proofs are generated with proper randomness for security
